SKY CRAWLER

LET'S
FLY!

TOTAL VOTES: 0

Drive over the dunes and fly through the sky as far as you can. Grab chai cans to keep the engine running and votes to collect along the way. Land on your wheels, not your head. Flip in the air for bonus votes.

Controller: right trigger gas, left trigger brake, A jump, right bumper or Y fly, Start to begin, Select to switch mode.

Jump pops the car off the ground when your wheels are down. Hold fly to lift off, but it burns a lot of chai. In the air, gas tips the nose up and brake tips it down. Watch for rocks, launch ramps and gaps: signs warn you before a gap.

Engine heat: holding gas or fly heats the engine, flying heats it fastest. At 100% the engine cuts out until it cools, so ease off before it gets there. Better engine upgrades cool it faster.

Power-ups: pink magnet pulls in votes for 8 seconds, purple x2 doubles every vote for 10 seconds, orange bolt boosts, blue shield saves one crash. Difficulty: EASY is relaxed, NORMAL is standard, HARD burns chai fast and forgives little. Every map generates its own kind of terrain, and the RANDOM map picks a new one every run: Snow is long and smooth, Grass has soft hills with plenty of rocks, India has a tricolor sky and green hills. Moon has very low gravity, Jungle is packed with rocks, Volcano has jagged ridges and lava gaps, Candy has pastel steps and Beach has soft sand with lots of ramps.

Keyboard: right arrow or D gas, left arrow or A brake, Space or up arrow jump, F or Shift fly, M switch mode, T terrain, N music, L level, R rainbow. Plane modes: no wheels, hold fly to climb, release to descend, gas and brake set speed, dive low to grab chai. Fighter is fast and thirsty, Airplane is slower, steadier and saves chai.
